text:
support_jane: Millennia Payments reporting a surge since 09:03 UTC, ~20% of requests returning 502/504 from hosted API. Customer provided 3 sample request IDs: rq_8a3f, rq_8a40, rq_8a41. They say issues started after a batch job at 08:58. Can oncall triage? urgent :rotating_light:

ingress-oncall: on it. is this tenant-wide (all models) or scoped to a single route/model? any recent auth/billing changes? :eyes:

support_jane: customer says all routes to our hosted inference endpoint for their tenant. no billing change on their side. attaching one repro curl and a short snippet from our gateway logs below.

support_jane: curl sample they ran:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/gpt-medium","input":"short prompt","tenant":"millennia-prod"}'
```

support_jane: gateway log snippet (sanitized):

```
2025-11-20T09:03:12Z gateway[ingress]: request_id=rq_8a3f tenant=millennia-prod enqueue_depth=512 max_depth=512 continuous_batch.backlog=1187 action=enqueue status=accept
2025-11-20T09:03:13Z gateway[ingress]: request_id=rq_8a3f tenant=millennia-prod route=rwd/gpt-medium dispatch_delay_ms=10234 result=early_reject code=502
2025-11-20T09:03:14Z runtime[cbatcher]: tenant=millennia-prod backlog_len=1204 avg_batch_ms=430 kv_cache_miss_rate=0.67
2025-11-20T09:03:15Z gateway[ingress]: request_id=rq_8a40 tenant=millennia-prod enqueue_depth=498 continuous_batch.backlog=1199 result=timeout code=504
```

ops-bot: [ALERT] tenant_qdepth_threshold breach for tenant=millennia-prod qdepth=512 (>400) at 2025-11-20T09:03:12Z

kevin: looking at metrics now. continuous-batcher backlog is climbing; dequeue rate can't keep up. appears to be a sustained millisecond-per-batch increase (avg_batch_ms ~400ms -> amplifies queue). Not seeing obvious auth errors. traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/rq_8a3f :eyes:

alex: initial theory: very high concurrency of short requests + long model latency due to KV cache churn (misses) -> continuous batching groups too many and p95 blows up. short-term mitigations: 1) tighten tenant concurrency limit, 2) enable fallback to quantized smaller model for that tenant, 3) bump dedicated pool for few mins. We can flip 1 and 3 quickly.

sam: can we get distribution of sequence lengths and tokens per request? if most requests are tiny we can lower batch window to reduce tail latency. also check if a single client is spamming with many connections.

support_jane: customer rep (millennia_ops) just posted: "we kicked off a reconciliation job that fan-out'd ~1500 small requests in 90s starting 08:58. not expected to hit your API so hard, sorry."

kevin: that explains spike. repro steps I used locally to reproduce queue growth:

```
for i in {1..1500}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd/gpt-medium","input":"ping","tenant":"millennia-prod"}' &
done
```

kevin: results: queue soared to 1100 backlog, p95 latency > 7s, early_rejects -> 502s.

alex: patch plan I'm pushing in runtime: reduce continuous-batcher.max_batch_window_ms from 200 to 80 for tenant millennia-prod, and set per-tenant concurrency cap to 60. also add emergency routing to fallback model rwd/gpt-small-quant for that tenant. snippet:

```
# temp route override
routes:
  tenant: millennia-prod
  concurrency: 60
  fallback_model: rwd/gpt-small-quant
  batch_window_ms: 80
```

ops-bot: deploy triggered by alex (deploy/patch/4312) at 2025-11-20T09:07:02Z — rolling to 3 runtime pods.

kevin: also increased KV cache TTL for tenant keys from 5s -> 30s to reduce churn: applied config change.

ingress-oncall: applied temporary per-tenant rate-limit 60 concurrent, enabling fallback. monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/tenant/millennia-prod

support_jane: relaying to customer. they say they can pause the reconciliation job for 10m while we stabilize. ETA ask: how long to expect improvement?

alex: should see backlog drop within one batch-window cycle (~1-2s) per pod once deploy completes and concurrency enforced. overall improvement in 30-90s.

ops-bot: [DEPLOY] runtime/patch/4312 completed at 2025-11-20T09:08:20Z (3/3 pods).

kevin: metrics now: backlog down to 120, qdepth=98, p95 ~180ms, 502s -> 0.8% :thumbsup:

millennia_ops: "we paused the job, seeing significant improvement — thanks. we'll retry with a slower ramp. open to suggestions on recommended rate limits."

support_jane: noted. we'll follow up with recommended tenant rate limits and batching guidance. opening a post-incident doc and a customer-facing summary.

sam: follow-up tuning: for workloads with many tiny requests, set batch_window_ms to 50-100, enable prefix KV caching, and consider small-quant fallback to reduce per-token cost and latency. I'll draft tuning notes.

support_jane: thanks everyone — closing this Slack thread once post-incident writeup is ready. :white_check_mark:
